Branch `fix/fft-planner-reuse` (based on 6e41e8b) has one commit, `539da7a Reuse one FFT planner across channels`. fmt, clippy and the full test suite all pass, and the new regression test runs and passes.

**What changed**
- **`src/stft.rs`:** I added crate-private `analytic_signal_with(data, &mut FftPlanner<f64>)` and `stft_with(data, nfft, no_overlap, &mut FftPlanner<f64>)`. The public `analytic_signal` and `stft` keep their signatures and now call these with a fresh planner. A new unit test, `stft::tests::shared_planner_matches_fresh_planner`, checks that a reused planner gives exactly the same results as a fresh one, for both functions.
- **`src/music.rs`:** `estimate_doa_from_real`, `ifb_music_spectrum` and `select_bins_by_energy` each create one `FftPlanner` per call and pass it to every channel. Apart from the import, this is the only change there.
- No doc, README or CLAUDE.md changes were needed: the public API and the `MusicError` contract are the same, and the new test is a unit test, which CLAUDE.md doesn't list.

**Results** (own target dir, `CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=1`, as you corrected)
- `cargo fmt --check`: passes.
- `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings`: no warnings.
- `cargo test -- --include-ignored`, all passed:

| Suite | Passed |
|---|---|
| lib (includes the new test) | 43 |
| broadband | 14 |
| errors | 17 |
| golden | 9 |
| ifb | 5 |
| integration | 3 |
| noisy_data | 6 |
| synthetic | 11 |
| doctests | 7 |

The golden tests pass unchanged, so the output is the same bit for bit.

**Earlier failure, now void:** my first run used the shared target dir and showed `ifb_duplicate_and_reordered_bins_are_ignored` failing. That test doesn't exist in my tree, so cargo ran another agent's binary, as you warned. Those results don't count.

**Benchmark:** inconclusive. Median times with `BENCH_SCALE=0.05`, base binary vs. head binary, run alternately twice; load average was 5–9 on 3 cores:

| Workload | Base | Head |
|---|---|---|
| narrowband 1 s | 13.8 / 10.6 ms | 10.5 / 8.8 ms |
| narrowband 2 s | 26.7 / 23.9 ms | 20.3 / 21.8 ms |
| ifb_one_bin 1 s | 1.72 / 1.66 ms | 1.76 / 1.72 ms |
| ifb_one_bin 2 s | 3.32 / 3.23 ms | 4.88 / 3.36 ms |
| ifb_all_bins 1 s | 7.9 / 7.5 ms | 9.1 / 7.8 ms |

Run-to-run noise on this busy machine is bigger than any effect. Narrowband may be slightly faster with the change; no gain shows up for IFB. Planning a 160-point FFT costs little next to the per-bin eigendecompositions, so a large speed-up isn't expected. The CSVs and the two benchmark binaries are in `/tmp/claude-1000/-home-orchid-projects-musicrs/860b07ee-3f92-4815-ab52-690d0ae10c8e/scratchpad/` (`bench_base_1.csv`, `bench_head_1.csv`, `bench_base_2.csv`, `bench_head_2.csv`). Nothing was written to `bench/results/`.

Nothing was pushed or merged, and the worktree is clean.
